menu_options.direct: Autonomous - Home Assistant logs in to WebUntis itself (Untis Mobile QR code)

direct.title: WebUntis (autonomous)
direct.description: In WebUntis: Profile → Freigaben / Access → Untis Mobile → show QR code. Scan it with a phone camera and paste the text that starts with untis://setschool?… into the first field. (Or fill in the four fields below.)

parent.title: SSC Parent link
parent.description: On your Mac: SSC → Settings → Parent mode → Copy link. Paste the browser link here.

error.invalid_qr: That isn't a complete Untis Mobile QR text (untis://setschool?url=…&school=…&user=…&key=…).
error.invalid_auth: WebUntis refused the login. Was the QR code regenerated, or is this computer's clock off by more than a minute?
error.invalid_link: That isn't an SSC Parent link (http://…:8766/p/<code>/ on your home network).

abort.already_configured: This account/link is already set up.
